comment: Probably the most difficult class I've taken but he is a very nice person. Knows what he teaches if you love the subject, he loves you

Very good professor; lectures alternate between being very interesting & very boring; textbook can get difficult to read at times; will explain topics again w/o making you feel dumb; lots of worksheets; midterm & final are significantly harder the any worksheet given in class, but will curve; participation will make it the class much more enjoyable
